nodes.label: Cannibalization Prevention
nodes.rationale: Mandatory audit before any optimization so multiple pages do not compete for the same query.

nodes.label: Scan-Fix-Rescan Loop
nodes.rationale: AI assistants optimize for the demo; fixes must be verified by rescan rather than asserted.

nodes.label: Rule: Inputs Validated at Trust Boundary

nodes.label: Substance Over Checkbox
nodes.rationale: Controls must actually reduce risk, not merely satisfy an auditor checklist.

nodes.label: Flake Triage Table
nodes.rationale: A flaky test is a bug; tests must be deterministic, isolated, fast

nodes.label: Seeded Photo / Place Name Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Several seeded photos appear not to depict the named venue - likely scraped image misattribution; flag for data QA

nodes.label: Seeded Delhi Place Photos
nodes.rationale: Google-Maps-style place photos bundled in public/seeded-assets to seed demo gems for Delhi so the map is populated offline/demo

nodes.label: Glasswork as Altitude
nodes.rationale: Blur/translucency encodes spatial hierarchy of overlays above the map.

nodes.label: exifr Library
nodes.rationale: Chosen over exif-js/piexifjs for HEIC support, tree-shaking and async API.

nodes.label: GPS Fires on Step 2 Entry
nodes.rationale: GPS auto-detect via useEffect on StepPin mount instead of button click to reduce friction.

nodes.label: Canvas Compression Strips EXIF
nodes.rationale: compressImage() redraws on canvas and loses metadata, so GPS must be read from the original file first.

nodes.label: Idempotent Payment Creation
nodes.rationale: Money must move exactly once or not at all; webhooks treated as source of truth, reconciliation always.

nodes.label: Consent Enforced at Write Path
nodes.rationale: Recorded consent is useless unless it gates operations

nodes.label: Persistent Care Profile
nodes.rationale: Minimal profile holding only what is needed for the current care plan; must never grow into a full medical record

nodes.label: HIPAA-Aware Communication
nodes.rationale: Never request, store, or repeat sensitive information unnecessarily
